lead.title: FCC lifts decades-old restriction on drone cellular operations
lead.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) voted to open 50 megahertz of spectrum in the 800 MHz cellular band for uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS). This decision removes a longstanding restriction on airborne use of the band, potentially giving drone operators access to additional licensed spectrum for communications and other operations.

stories.title: Waymo And Toyota Start Testing Robotaxis In Japan Using Toyota bZ4X From 2027
stories.summary: Waymo and Toyota will begin testing factory-built bZ4X robotaxis in Japan in 2027, with Toyota manufacturing the vehicles and installing Waymo hardware at its Takaoka plant. The companies plan to expand the service to the United Kingdom and other markets after Japan, targeting Level 4 autonomous driving.

stories.title: Trump Orders US Talks on Robotics and Industrial Machinery Imports
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump directed the Department of Commerce and the Office of the United States Trade Representative to negotiate with foreign trading partners over imports of robotics, industrial machinery and related components. The October 28, 2026, proclamation cites national security concerns and dependence on foreign suppliers.

stories.title: Using 5G networks for drone detection – two major steps forward in one day
stories.summary: Ericsson and AT&T demonstrated 5G drone detection in Arlington, Texas, on October 30, while NATO allies tested counter-UAS initiatives at Ādaži Military Base in Riga, Latvia. The trials included jamming drone swarms and linking detection systems to air defense guns, utilizing passive radio wave reflections to track objects.

stories.title: Rivian’s autonomy gamble faces its first real test
stories.summary: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe plans to roll out point-to-point hands-free driving to employees in 2026 and customers in 2027, followed by robotaxi vehicles with Uber in 2028. The company reported $605 million in software and subscription revenue in Q3 2026, a 45 percent increase year over year, while warning that adding processors and lidar sensors to R2 models could reduce profits.

stories.title: Joby Brings Its Vertical Takeoff and Landing Air Taxi to Florida
stories.summary: Joby Aviation launched a week of piloted electric air taxi flights across Florida, operating from Tampa to Orlando and the Space Coast. These are Florida’s first flights under the White House-backed eIPP program, announced by the U.S. Department of Transportation in March 2026, to help map the state’s planned Aerial Highway Network.

stories.title: Wisk Opens Its Hollister Vertiport as the FAA Rewrites Pad Rules
stories.summary: Wisk Aero opened its 100-foot by 100-foot vertiport at Hollister Municipal Airport in California on October 29, nine weeks after construction began. The site, built to existing FAA standards, will host surrogate helicopters and Generation 6 aircraft for precision landing tests that feed the FAA’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. The FAA posted a draft standard to replace current vertiport rules on October 22, with final standards expected in summer 2027.

stories.title: Historic Flight Path Reimagined: Electric Aircraft Cross Tampa Bay In Air Taxi Test
stories.summary: Two electric aircraft flew across Tampa Bay on Friday, tracing the 1914 route of aviator Tony Jannus to test airborne transit. The Florida Department of Transportation and Federal Aviation Administration used the flights to gather data for future commercial air taxi safety rules and vertiport standards.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail CEO Ian Choudri resigns after watchdog flags $543,000 in improper travel payments
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, CEO of the California High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned Wednesday after a state watchdog found the agency paid $543,000 in unauthorized travel reimbursements. The California Office of the Inspector General reported the funds covered international and out-of-state trips, including $81,000 for visits to gyms, an escape room, and a nightclub. Joe Stephenshaw, director of the California Department of Finance, will serve as interim CEO.

stories.title: Toyota and Waymo team to deliver driverless taxis in Japan
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo began testing bZ4X robotaxis at the Takaoka plant in Toyota City, where they are equipping the vehicles with Waymo's hardware and software. After validations and Level 4 autonomous driving approvals, the companies will release the driverless bZ4X vehicles in Japan as early as 2027.

stories.title: Trump Administration Halts Tariffs on Robotics, Industrial Machinery
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced it will impose no new tariffs on robotics, industrial machinery, and their parts and components. Following a Section 232 investigation, the administration directed the Secretary of Commerce and the Office of the United States Trade Representative to negotiate agreements to address national security threats posed by related imports.

stories.title: Ondas stock drops despite expanded FEMA counter-drone funding
stories.summary: Ondas shares fell 6.77% to ~$6.41 on Friday despite the company outlining opportunities to supply counter-drone systems under FEMA’s expanded $500 million grant program. The grant includes an additional $250 million, extending eligibility to all 50 states, five territories, and the District of Columbia.

stories.title: New MOKH Module for Autonomous Navigation Appears in Geran Drones – DIU
stories.summary: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence reported that Russian Geran-class drones began using a new MOKH module in late summer 2026 to improve autonomous navigation accuracy without satellite signals. The system uses two additional wing sensors to form a three-point measurement triangle, allowing drones to strike targets even if other guidance systems are jammed.

stories.title: Federal Railroad Administration awards nearly $50 million to 2 Illinois railroads
Humanoid developer Agility now expects to raise $465M in SPAC deal
stories.summary: Agility Robotics Inc. and Churchill Capital Corp XI expect to raise about $465 million in a proposed SPAC merger, a decrease from the $620 million predicted in June. The Salem, Ore.-based company aims to close the transaction on Nov. 4 and begin deliveries to early-access customers in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: AT&T and Ericsson “use 5G network for drone detection in Arlington”
stories.summary: AT&T and Ericsson demonstrated drone detection using 5G network sensing in Arlington, Texas, during a major sporting event. The system detected and tracked multiple drones flying at altitudes between 300 and 400 feet using existing cellular towers and AI-enabled algorithms.

stories.title: Ukraine Reports First Drone Interception of Russian KUB-2E Loitering Munition
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Posipaky drone unit shot down a Russian KUB-2E loitering munition in the Zaporizhzhia sector using a General Chereshnia AIR interceptor. The National Association of Ukrainian Defense Industries described it as the first confirmed interception of the weapon by a frontline interceptor drone.

stories.title: Sydney Metro’s Southwest extension opens over former suburban railway
Tesla Pushes Australia to Allow Driverless Trials Two Years Early
stories.summary: Tesla asked Australia’s Senate to allow public-road autonomous vehicle trials in 2027 and to accelerate the proposed Autonomous Vehicle Safety Law from an expected 2029 start to 2027. The company cited more than 160 million kilometers of FSD (Supervised) driving across Australia and New Zealand since September 2025, claiming the shift would unlock more than A$10 billion in benefits.

stories.title: Experimental supersonic NASA jet lands in BHM along cross-country flight
stories.summary: NASA's Lockheed Martin X-59 Quesst landed at Birmingham-Shuttlesworth International Airport on Thursday, October 29, during a cross-country flight from California to the Kennedy Space Center. The aircraft will fly the final leg of its journey today, after which NASA will survey public reactions to its overhead noise to inform regulators on acceptable thresholds for supersonic commercial flights.

stories.title: DJI wants its enterprise drones back in the air in 25 seconds
stories.summary: DJI announced the Dock 4, its first automated docking system to feature battery swapping, which replaces a depleted drone battery with a charged one in 25 seconds. The system pairs with the new DJI Matrice 5TD, an enterprise drone offering up to 59 minutes of flight time and thermal imaging, though the new system is unlikely to become available for purchase in the United States.

stories.title: Gov. Braun launches Midwest UAS Test Site, advancing defense innovation, commercialization & leadership
stories.summary: Indiana Governor Mike Braun launched the Midwest UAS Test Site in Terre Haute, one of nine uncrewed aircraft systems test sites designated by the Federal Aviation Administration. The site is now accepting members and supporting flight-test operations for companies, defense organizations, and researchers developing drone and autonomous aviation technologies.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Selects Siemens to Build Trains for 2033 Launch
stories.summary: The California High-Speed Rail Authority approved a contract with Siemens Mobility to design and manufacture the first three high-speed trains for its network, targeting passenger service by 2033.

stories.title: FAA: Florida Takes the Lead in Advanced Air Mobility
stories.summary: FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford says Florida will become a global hub for the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program. Real-world operations are expected to begin by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics raises US$100 million to build AI-powered autonomous factory in US
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics raised US$100 million in an oversubscribed Series A round led by Marlinspike Partners to expand its 130,000-square-foot facility in Emeryville, California. The funding will support robotics development and recruitment for an AI-powered assembly factory serving US defense contractors and industrial hardware producers.

stories.title: From Airport to Rome’s City Center in 10 Minutes? ITA Airways and Archer Have a Plan
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and ITA Airways announced plans to develop electric air taxi links between Italian airports and city centers, making the airline the first European carrier to join Archer’s partner network. The agreement covers potential services in major Italian cities, with Archer estimating a flight from Rome Fiumicino Airport to the city center would take less than 10 minutes.

stories.title: FCC lifts decades-old restriction on drone cellular operations
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) voted to open 50 megahertz of spectrum in the 800 MHz cellular band for uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS). This decision removes a longstanding restriction on airborne use of the band, potentially giving drone operators access to additional licensed spectrum for communications and other operations.

stories.title: Wisk Opens Vertiport at Hollister Municipal Airport with Ribbon Cutting
stories.summary: Wisk Aero opened a 100-foot by 100-foot vertiport at Hollister Municipal Airport in California on October 29, 2026. The facility supports piloted and autonomous operations, serving as a testbed for precision landing technologies and the FAA’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program.

stories.title: Dnipro station drone strike kills 15 despite evacuation call over 10 minutes before
stories.summary: The death toll from the Dnipro station drone strike rose to 15 on October 30, after a jet-powered drone hit a platform beside a Zaporizhzhia-bound commuter train a day earlier. Ukrzaliznytsia said the Russian drone struck one of the platforms at Dnipro’s railway station on October 29 while train No. 866 Dnipro–Zaporizhzhia was standing there.

stories.title: A Tesla Dashcam Caught a Zoox Robotaxi Involved in an Accident, But Was It Really at Fault?
stories.summary: A white SUV crashed into the rear of a Zoox robotaxi at a Las Vegas intersection after the autonomous vehicle stopped to yield to an ambulance. The video, which has garnered 1.4 million views, suggests the SUV driver failed to slow down despite having sufficient time to avoid the collision.

stories.title: Toyota to Launch Self-Driving Taxis in 2027
stories.summary: Toyota Motor will begin operating fully autonomous taxis in 2027 through a partnership with Waymo, using Toyota's bZ4X electric vehicles manufactured at the Takaoka Plant in Toyota City, Aichi Prefecture. The companies have yet to determine where the vehicles will operate, with details of initial service areas to be considered in the coming months.

stories.title: Autonomous Vehicles Market to Reach USD 90,331.3 Million by 2036; United States Leads at 10.2% CAGR, United Ki
stories.summary: Future Market Insights projects the global autonomous vehicles market will reach USD 90,331.3 million by 2036, expanding at an 8.7% compound annual growth rate from 2026. The United States is forecast to lead growth at a 10.2% CAGR, while the United Kingdom is projected to record an 8.2% CAGR.

stories.title: Florida’s Flying Taxi Epoch: eVTOL Takes Flight Across Tampa Bay
stories.summary: Joby Aviation conducted a test flight of an electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft across Tampa Bay, launching from Albert Whitted Airport and landing at Tampa International Airport. This marks Florida’s official pilot under the Federal Aviation Administration’s Electric-Integration Pilot Program, with the state selected as one of eight jurisdictions to collaborate with the U.S. Department of Transportation and the FAA on integrating next-generation aircraft into urban airspaces.

stories.title: Tesla Adds New Calm Mode to Robotaxi
stories.summary: Tesla introduced a new Calm Mode for Robotaxi passengers that turns off the driving visualization and sets cabin lighting to a relaxing state. The company also announced that Robotaxi now operates until 2 AM every day.

stories.title: Ribbit, Canadian Researchers Test Autonomous Aircraft in Rescue Exercise
stories.summary: Ribbit and the National Research Council of Canada (NRC) conducted a search-and-rescue exercise near Ottawa where an autonomous Cessna 150 and Bell 412EP helicopter operated under a single mission commander. The demonstration followed more than three years of cooperation, including contracted testing for civilian and military applications in public safety, tactical aviation, and joint operations.

stories.title: Saud bin Saqr attends launch of autonomous mobility framework, Autonomous Vehicle Testing Zone Initiative in Ras Al Khaimah
Kodiak AI Reports 99% Autonomy Readiness for Driverless Long-Haul Launch, Targets End-of-2026 Commercial Service
stories.summary: Kodiak AI announced its Autonomy Readiness Measure for long-haul driverless operations reached 99%, targeting commercial service launch by the end of 2026 on Interstate 45 between Dallas and Houston. The company plans to begin with a 219-mile driverless route for IKEA, following earlier deployments in the Permian Basin.

stories.title: Exercise proves why traditional skills and drills still matter in a drone-dominated battlefield
China’s GJ-21 stealth drone completes first takeoff and landing aboard Type 076 Sichuan amphibious assault ship
stories.summary: China's People's Liberation Army Navy confirmed on October 30, 2026, that the GJ-21 stealth drone completed its first electromagnetic catapult launch and arrested landing aboard the Type 076 Sichuan amphibious assault ship. Conducted during October sea trials, the test validates carrier-grade launch and recovery systems on the 50,000-tonne vessel, though no video footage has been publicly released.

stories.title: ‘Trust in high-speed rail shattered,’ says Spanish premier after deadly accident
stories.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez acknowledged that trust in high-speed rail has been shattered after a collision near Urda killed at least 69 people and injured 110. Transport Minister Oscar Puente stated that a control center worker authorized a Renfe train to proceed at up to 200 kilometers per hour despite a stationary train ahead, violating safety protocols.

stories.title: Spain’s trust in high-speed rail ‘broken’ after second deadly crash this year, says PM
stories.summary: Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, admitted “trust in high-speed rail has been broken” after Wednesday’s train collision that killed at least 69 people, injured more than 100 and prompted a national debate on the safety of the country’s rail network. Sánchez said Spain was “working tirelessly” to provide information as quickly as possible to the families of the victims – who include people from at least 23 different foreign countries – adding his government was committed to finding what had caused the country’s second deadly train collision this year.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics Raises $100M to Expand AI-Driven Manufacturing
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics raised $100 million in Series A funding led by Marlinspike Partners to expand its Emeryville, California facility and deploy AI models in manufacturing. The company plans to hire researchers and engineers to support its contract manufacturing of drones, underwater vehicles, and satellite components.

stories.title: ACS and CX2 Partner to Advance Integrated Counter-Drone Defense Capabilities
stories.summary: Allen Control Systems and CX2 announced a strategic partnership on Oct. 30, 2026, to develop integrated counter-drone capabilities for the United States and its allies. The collaboration combines ACS’s Bullfrog autonomous weapon station with CX2’s RF sensing and electronic warfare technology to create layered defense solutions for mobile, expeditionary, fixed-site, and maritime operations.

stories.title: Bleu Robotics Raises €5M in Funding to Speed Humanoid Robot Deployment in Factories
stories.summary: France’s Bleu Robotics raised €5 million in pre-seed funding to develop AI software that teaches humanoid robots new factory tasks with fewer demonstrations. The company said its system allows robots to be retrained as production requirements change or when they are moved to another location.

stories.title: Nepali Army to receive Robinson SPIRIT uncrewed aircraft
stories.summary: Robinson Unmanned is to supply its SPIRIT small uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) to the Nepali Army under a US Foreign Military Sales contract. The agreement, awarded to Robinson subsidiary Ascent AeroSystems through the US Naval Air Systems Command, includes SPIRIT aircraft, mission payloads, spare parts, operator training, and technical support.

stories.title: America’s answer to the mighty Concorde was to take to the skies in 2029 and leave the world in awe, but to date, the airframe is not built, its massive factory lies idle, and certification hurdles have convinced United Airlines the supersonic jet won’t take off this decade
Schneider partners with Norfolk Southern; raises outlook despite Q3 miss
stories.summary: Schneider National announced Thursday it has inked a deal to utilize Norfolk Southern’s rail network in the East, with the new service beginning in January. The company also raised the bottom end of its full-year adjusted EPS guidance range by 10 cents to a new range of $1 to $1.10.

stories.title: DJI's 1280 Thermal Drones Skip the US. Economists Saw This Coming
stories.summary: DJI launched the Matrice 5TD with Dock 4 on October 14, 2026, featuring a 1280 by 1024 thermal camera, but no U.S. dealer can sell it because the FCC placed foreign-made drones on its Covered List on December 22, 2025. The FCC’s Docket 26-189 proposal would bar the import and sale of foreign drones with thermal imaging, which would reach the Matrice 4T.

stories.title: Waymo’s next robotaxi is a purpose-built Toyota bZ4X
stories.summary: Waymo announced it will launch a robotaxi service in Tokyo in 2027 using Toyota bZ4X electric SUVs assembled at Toyota’s Takaoka plant in Japan. The vehicles will have self-driving sensors and computers installed directly on the assembly line, with initial testing starting next year and subsequent rollouts planned for the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Russia Is Targeting Europe’s Defense Chiefs and Drone Start-Ups
stories.summary: Officials from five European intelligence agencies warned that Russia's G.R.U. is expanding plans to attack executives in the defense industry, including drone start-ups, to weaken support for Kyiv. Germany's domestic intelligence agency advises executives to hire private security, while Poland warns the sabotage campaign could soon cost lives and calls on NATO for a decisive response.

stories.title: Ukrainian experts launch security index to help Europe tackle rising drone threat
stories.summary: New Age Defense and the Ukrainian think tank BRDO launched a Drone Security Index on Oct. 30 to assess European countries' preparedness for drone attacks. The index scores nations out of 100 across prevention, detection, response, and recovery, with pilot assessments scheduled for Germany and Poland in November.

stories.title: Varjo develops virtual C-UAS training systems with Finnish Defence Forces
stories.summary: The Finnish Defence Forces Innovation Unit and Varjo are collaborating to test and develop virtual technologies for counter-uncrewed aerial systems (C-UAS) training using the Varjo XR-4 Series mixed reality headset. The company said in a 29 October press release that the preparations for the partnership began in February.

stories.title: The FAA is Helping Design Vertiports. But Who Will Change the Batteries?
stories.summary: The FAA published Draft Advisory Circular 150/5390-4 on October 22, 2026, providing proposed guidance for planning, designing, and constructing facilities that will accommodate a new generation of aircraft, including eVTOL vehicles. The document addresses everything from touchdown areas and approach surfaces to lighting, rooftop installations, and electric charging infrastructure.

stories.title: ITA Airways Taps Archer for Italian Air Taxi Plans
stories.summary: ITA Airways signed a preliminary agreement with Archer Aviation to develop electric air taxi services in Italy using Archer’s four-passenger Midnight eVTOL aircraft. Archer stated the partnership depends on signing definitive agreements and meeting unspecified conditions, while ITA aims to tie eVTOL flights into its airline network with unspecified partners operating the aircraft.

stories.title: Waymo picks Toyota bZ4X as its next robotaxi, starting in Japan in 2027
stories.summary: Waymo is adding the Toyota bZ4X to its robotaxi lineup, with Toyota building a custom version at its Takaoka plant in Japan. A test fleet will start operating there in 2027, marking the first vehicle from the partnership signed last year.

stories.title: CN 3Q profit rises 6% as freight revenue climbs
stories.summary: Canadian National Railway reported a 6% increase in third-quarter profit Friday, earning C$1.209 billion as revenue rose 15% to $3.42 billion. The Montreal-based railway maintained its full-year earnings outlook, stating growth was tracking toward the upper end of its forecast range.

stories.title: China tests stealth drone takeoff and landing from warship
stories.summary: China said Friday that the GJ-21 stealth drone completed its first takeoff and landing from the Sichuan, the country’s first Type 076 amphibious assault ship equipped with an electromagnetic catapult. The test, conducted during a sea voyage, demonstrated the Chinese Navy’s ability to launch and recover fixed-wing stealth drones from large maritime combat platforms.

stories.title: EHang plans fleet of uncrewed passenger-carrying eVTOLs for Thailand
stories.summary: EHang plans to deploy a fleet of 25 EH216-S uncrewed passenger-carrying eVTOL aircraft in Thailand to support regional operations. The company will also demonstrate EH216-S flights in Bangkok in December during the International Civil Aviation Organisation AAM Symposium.

stories.title: Zipline Claims 68% Less Noise, Alibaba Wins Ruling, MI Organ Flights
Finnish rolling stock company orders more winterised Flirt commuter EMUs
stories.summary: RailStock Finland ordered 21 Stadler Flirt Sm7 electric multiple-units on October 30, using an option from a contract originally signed by VR in November 2022. The order brings the total to 41 units, with all expected in service by 2030.

stories.title: Spain’s prime minister says trust in high-speed rail has been shattered after deadly crash
stories.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez pledged to strengthen the high-speed rail system after a collision near Urda killed at least 69 people and injured 110. Transport Minister Oscar Puente stated that a control center worker authorized a Renfe train to proceed at normal speed despite a stationary train ahead, violating safety protocols.

stories.title: Spain train crash: Transport minister says he won't resign over disaster
stories.summary: Spain's transport minister Óscar Puente refused to resign over the high-speed rail collision near Urda that killed at least 69 people. He stated his duty is to resolve the problem, noting that a preliminary report found the Renfe train was travelling between 160km/h and 200km/h when it struck a stationary Iryo train.

stories.title: ‘They come in droves’: How robotaxis hog EV chargers in one corner of Southern California
stories.summary: Waymo received approval from California regulators to expand its service area across 18 counties, including San Diego and Sacramento. San Diego City Council voted unanimously on Sept. 14 to urge state lawmakers to give cities more control over autonomous vehicle operations and keep charging hubs away from homes and schools.

stories.title: DRONERESPONDERS partners with HelpNow Project to give public safety drone teams hands-on access to hosted TAK
NASA's Supersonic X-59 Heads for Florida Vacation
stories.summary: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said Wednesday that the X-59 is "making her way" to Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The aircraft is expected to land at the Space Florida Launch and Landing Facility (KTTS) in Titusville this week and reportedly make an appearance at NASA's Max Power expo and airshow on November 8-9.

stories.title: Spain Investigates Deadly High Speed Train Crash That Killed 69
stories.summary: Spanish authorities are investigating a high-speed train collision in Toledo province that killed 69 people and injured many others, with officials examining signaling failures and railway safety systems. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said people from 27 nationalities may be among those killed or injured in the disaster, which occurred on Wednesday.

stories.title: Ondas Positions Field-Proven Aerial Security Portfolio to Support $250 Million FEMA Counter-Drone Grant Program
stories.summary: Ondas Inc. outlined how its Aerial Security portfolio positions the company to support state, local, tribal, and territorial agencies as the Federal Emergency Management Agency extends its Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems Grant Program to communities nationwide. The company will participate in the 2nd Annual Countering the Threat: Drone Security Industry & SLTT Grant Forum on November 9, 2026, hosted by the White House Task Force on the 2028 Summer Olympics, DRONERESPONDERS, and the Commercial Drone Alliance.

stories.title: Schneider to shift eastern rail business to Norfolk Southern from CSX
stories.summary: Schneider announced on Oct. 29 that it will shift its eastern rail business from CSX to Norfolk Southern, effective in November. The agreement pairs Schneider's equipment with Norfolk Southern's 22-state intermodal network to expand domestic capacity and attract freight currently moving by truck.

stories.title: Iran’s Drone and Missile Swarms Hit US Bases Faster Than Interceptors Could Be Replaced, and the Air Force Tested the A-10 Warthog and Its 30mm Gatling Gun as a Cheaper Counter-Drone Interceptor
Tesla Robotaxi Now Operates 20 Hours Per Day
stories.summary: Tesla extended its Robotaxi operating hours to 20 hours daily, with rides now available from 6 AM until 2 AM. The company also added features including a rear view camera feed, trip sharing, and Grok availability on Model Y vehicles.

stories.title: Toyota to Build Waymo Robotaxis in Japan, With Fleet Testing Set for 2027
stories.summary: Toyota will build autonomous bZ4X vehicles equipped with Waymo’s self-driving technology at its Takaoka plant in Japan, with testing of the fleet set to begin in 2027. The companies described the collaboration on the future fully autonomous ride-hailing service in Japan as the country’s first using high-volume, domestically manufactured vehicles.

stories.title: Toyota and Waymo plan autonomous fleet tests amid UK rollout debate
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo agreed to test a fleet of autonomous BZ4X vehicles in Japan in 2027, with deployment to the UK and other markets planned for subsequent years. Toyota will build the vehicles and integrate Waymo hardware at its Takaoka factory, including automatic doors.

stories.title: Tesla wants Australian robotaxi trials in 2027
stories.summary: Tesla urged the Australian government to support an autonomous vehicle trial in 2027 by granting permits for testing on public roads, in a 16 October submission to a parliamentary inquiry on productivity. The company argued that accelerating the Automated Vehicle Safety Law implementation from 2029 to 2027 would save hundreds of lives and unlock more than $10 billion in benefits.

stories.title: Northrop Grumman gets $56M to upgrade one MQ-4C Triton drone
European UAS and C-UAS tech development hubs to be located in Latvia and Netherlands
stories.summary: European Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis announced that two drone technology hubs will be established in 2027 in Latvia and the Netherlands to develop and test military drone and counter-drone concepts. The Latvia hub will focus on land and air technologies, while the Netherlands hub will address naval capabilities and underwater infrastructure protection.

stories.title: I’m a train safety expert. Here’s why I would reconsider travel on Spain’s high-speed rail
stories.summary: Francisco Badea Romero, a railway certification expert at Nebrija University, said he would avoid Spain's high-speed rail following a crash that killed 69 people on 28 October. He argued that multiple safety systems failed to prevent the collision between an Iryo and a Renfe train in Toledo province.

stories.title: SkyDrive Signs R&D Memorandum with Six Singapore Technology Companies
EHang Establishes Thailand Hub to Support Regional eVTOL Deployment
Toyota, Waymo to test self-driving bZ4Xs in Japan in 2027
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo will begin testing autonomous bZ4X electric vehicles in Japan in 2027, with deployment in Britain planned for subsequent years. Toyota will build the vehicles at its Takaoka plant, where Waymo’s autonomous-driving hardware will be installed, while initial operations will involve a small number of vehicles.

stories.title: How cities can make room for robotaxis
stories.summary: Kenan Zhang, a professor at the EPFL Laboratory for Human-Oriented Mobility Eco-System, published studies in Transportation Research presenting artificial intelligence methods to coordinate large fleets of autonomous vehicles. The research uses reinforcement learning algorithms developed with real-world data from Shenzhen, China, to optimize vehicle waiting and parking locations, aiming to reduce waiting times and expand service to underserved suburban areas.

stories.title: The Wall Street Journal Hires Sean O’Kane to Cover Tesla and Autonomous Vehicles
stories.summary: The Wall Street Journal has hired Sean O’Kane as a reporter covering Tesla and autonomous vehicles. O’Kane, currently a senior reporter at TechCrunch, is expected to begin his new role in two weeks.

stories.title: Waymo Picks Toyota to Take Its Robotaxis Global
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo announced that autonomous bZ4X crossovers built at Toyota's Takaoka plant will start testing in Japan in 2027, with the United Kingdom next. Toyota describes the project as Japan’s first fully autonomous ride-hailing service using high-volume, domestically manufactured vehicles.

stories.title: Waymo Picks Toyota bZ4X as Robotaxi for Japan and UK, Tests From 2027
stories.summary: Waymo will use a Toyota bZ4X built in Japan as a robotaxi, with testing of an autonomous fleet starting in Japan in 2027 and deployment to the United Kingdom and other Waymo markets planned for later years, the companies said on Friday.

stories.title: New Georgia hub aims to take 26,000 containers off the road
African security forces in need of C-UAS capabilities, strategic report says
stories.summary: The Africa Center for Strategic Studies released a report stating that African security forces must invest in counter-unmanned aerial system (C-UAS) detection and mitigation capabilities. Author Nate Allen recommends adopting a risk-based doctrine that combines layered defenses, supply chain restrictions, and small UAS integration to counter armed non-state actors.

stories.title: Blue-green lights could signal driverless operation under NHTSA proposal
stories.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) proposed optional cyan-colored marker lights to identify vehicles operating under automated driving systems. The agency also suggested eliminating manual lighting control requirements for driverless vehicles while retaining functional turn signals and headlamp beams. Public comments are due Nov. 25, 2026.

stories.title: Archer and ITA Airways Plan Electric Air Taxi Network in Italy
Venti brings driverless yard trucks to US yards
stories.summary: Venti Technologies signed a long-term agreement with a Class I intermodal railroad in July to run more than 130 driverless trucks across eight sites by 2027. The company’s Oct. 1 release states the trucks will load, move, and unload containers during live yard operations with nobody in the cab and no dedicated lanes.

stories.title: Indiana drone test site launches with ceremony in Terre Haute
stories.summary: Indiana’s federally designated drone test site opened for flight testing Thursday, Oct. 29, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony at Terre Haute Regional Airport. The Midwest UAS Test Site of Indiana is intended to provide space for testing unmanned aircraft in active airspace for commercial and national security uses.

stories.title: Quebec farmers anticipate the impacts of the Alto high-speed rail project
stories.summary: Quebec farmers anticipate the impacts of the Alto high-speed rail project.

stories.title: Toyota and Waymo to deploy autonomous bZ4X EV fleet
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo will begin testing a fleet of autonomous, fully electric Toyota bZ4X models in Japan next year. The vehicles will be built at Toyota’s Takaoka plant, with the entire process, from assembling the base vehicle to integrating Waymo’s autonomous hardware, taking place under one roof.

stories.title: Electric air taxi to fly from St. Pete to Tampa International Airport in Florida test
stories.summary: Joby Aviation is expected to fly an electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft from Albert Whitted Airport to Tampa International Airport Friday morning, beginning a week of piloted test flights in Florida. The state is one of eight selected for the federal eVTOL Integration Pilot Program to test passenger transportation, cargo delivery, automation, and medical response.

stories.title: Matternet and Swisslog to bring drone delivery services to US hospitals
stories.summary: Matternet partnered with Swisslog Healthcare’s TransLogic to create an automated hospital transportation network combining drone delivery with pneumatic tube systems. The companies will launch the service in California, Florida, and Arizona during the first year, using Matternet’s M3 drone to carry packages up to 11 pounds within a 10-mile radius.

stories.title: MQ-9B drone with LoyalEye Radar Tracks Fighter Jets and Maritime Targets in U.S. Tests
stories.summary: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. and Saab announced on October 28, 2026, that an MQ-9B carrying LoyalEye radar pods simultaneously tracked fighter, commercial, and maritime targets during tests in Southern California. The companies did not disclose detection ranges or endurance figures, and the announcement does not establish operational readiness or identify a U.S. military acquisition decision.

stories.title: North Korea Turns Mock U.S. Abrams Tanks Into Drone Targets While Displaying Over 30 UAV Types
Singapore evaluates mobile C-UAS in Australia
stories.summary: The Singapore Armed Forces and Defence Science Technology Agency are evaluating a mobile counter-unmanned aerial system during Exercise Wallaby 2026 in Australia, which runs until November 2. The system detects and jams drones while mounted on a moving vehicle, though feedback indicated it did not always provide required detection on time.

stories.title: Spain's latest deadly train crash puts human error and systemic failure under scrutiny
stories.summary: Spain's transport minister blamed a traffic controller's judgment for Wednesday's Toledo collision, which killed 69 people, while unions cited deteriorating working conditions and repeated failures of the LZB safety system. A judge and a special government commission are investigating the crash, which was the second major incident on the Madrid-Seville line this year.

stories.title: Waymo And Toyota Will Soon Start Testing Their Robotaxis In Japan
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo will start testing an autonomous fleet of Toyota bZ4X electric vehicles in Japan in 2027. The companies plan to deploy the vehicles to the UK and other right-hand drive markets in the years that follow.

stories.title: From fishing village to the skies: How Malaysian engineer Ng Yon Wei is bringing ‘air taxis’ to life
stories.summary: TCab Tech signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Sidec to explore commercializing its E20 eVTOL aircraft in Malaysia. The company expects to begin commercial mass production within two years, with estimated fares of RM2 to RM3 per passenger per kilometre.

stories.title: Toyota and Waymo plan Japan robotaxi tests in 2027, target overseas markets
stories.summary: Waymo and Toyota plan to test autonomous Toyota bZ4X vehicles in Japan in 2027, with subsequent expansion to the U.K. and other markets. The vehicles will be assembled and equipped with Waymo’s autonomous driving hardware at Toyota’s Takaoka plant.

stories.title: EHang Establishes Overseas Regional Hub in Thailand to Support International eVTOL Deployment Across Southeast Asia and Other Emerging Markets
stories.summary: EHang Holdings Limited announced the establishment of an overseas regional hub in Thailand on Oct. 30, 2026, to support international electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft deployment. The company plans to deploy an initial fleet of 25 units of EH216-S pilotless passenger-carrying eVTOL aircraft in Thailand.

stories.title: EHang Establishes Overseas Regional Hub in Thailand to Support International eVTOL Deployment Across Southeast Asia and Other Emerging Markets
stories.summary: EHang Holdings Limited established an overseas regional hub in Thailand on Oct. 30, 2026, to support international electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft deployment across Southeast Asia. The company plans to deploy an initial fleet of 25 EH216-S pilotless passenger-carrying aircraft in Thailand for market-specific flight validation and operational preparation.

stories.title: Drone Near Lambeau Field Halts Packers-Panthers Game
stories.summary: Officials halted the Green Bay Packers-Carolina Panthers game in the third quarter after an unauthorized drone flew near Lambeau Field, ordering both teams off the field until the aircraft moved away. The Federal Aviation Administration bars drone flights within 3 nautical miles of stadiums seating 30,000 or more during NFL games.

stories.title: Toyota, Waymo start autonomous vehicle testing in Japan, UK deployment planned
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo will begin testing an autonomous Toyota bZ4X fleet in Japan in 2027, with vehicles built at the Takaoka plant in Aichi Prefecture. Deployment to the UK and other Waymo-serviced markets is planned for the following years.

stories.title: Toyota, Waymo start autonomous vehicle testing in Japan, UK deployment planned
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo will begin initial operations to test and validate an autonomous Toyota bZ4X fleet in Japan in 2027. Deployment to the UK and other Waymo-serviced markets is planned for the following years.

stories.title: North Korea wants “absolute superiority” in drones
stories.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for “absolute superiority” in drone technology at an Oct. 29 exhibition, where state media displayed a new large flying-wing stealth drone and first-person-view attack quadcopters. Kim stated that integrating high-level artificial intelligence into unmanned weapons should be a top military priority, though North Korea did not release specifications or confirm if the new aircraft has flown.

stories.title: ‘The sky is the limit’: Indiana launches statewide drone testing network
Toyota, Waymo bZ4X Japan 2027 Test Plan [2026]
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo will begin testing an autonomous fleet of Toyota bZ4X vehicles in Japan in 2027, with Toyota assembling the cars and integrating Waymo’s driving hardware at its Takaoka plant. The United Kingdom and other Waymo-serviced markets are planned for later years, but no specific dates or fleet sizes were disclosed.

stories.title: Finnish Defence Forces and Varjo announce collaboration – new technology for counter-UAS training
stories.summary: The Finnish Defence Forces Innovation Unit and Varjo are collaborating to test and develop virtual solutions for counter-UAS training. Preparations for this partnership started in February 2026.

stories.title: US Marines deploy C-UAS measures to protect air bases in the Middle East
stories.summary: US Marines assigned to Fleet Antiterrorism Security Team Central Command (FASTCENT) executed a direct, land-based counter-uncrewed aerial system (C-UAS) campaign in the US Central Command area of responsibility. The unit deployed the Drone Restricted Access Using Known Electromagnetic Warfare (DRAKE) system and maintained Coyote interceptors to support air defence bases under attack from drones.

stories.title: MARSS to build air and maritime counter-drone system for Kuwait
stories.summary: MARSS will deliver a nationwide air and maritime counter-drone defence system for Kuwait in a £370 million contract. The system, built around NiDAR, integrates electro-optical, radar, and sonar sensors with hard-kill interceptors and soft-kill jammers. The deal is expected to create around 100 new jobs in the UK, with some production potentially based in Bristol.

stories.title: Toyota bZ4X Set for Waymo Autonomous Fleet Tests in Japan
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo plan to start testing and validating a fleet of autonomous Toyota bZ4X vehicles in Japan in 2027, advancing their work on vehicles for driverless ride-hailing. The companies plan deployments in the United Kingdom and other markets served by Waymo in subsequent years.

stories.title: RoboWorld 2026 gathers 20 countries and 400 firms in South Korea to showcase AI robotics
stories.summary: The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources will host RoboWorld 2026 from Nov. 4 at Kintex Exhibition Hall 1 in Goyang, Gyeonggi. The four-day event features 1,200 booths and about 400 companies from 20 countries, focusing on humanoids, AI transformation in manufacturing, and physical artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Tesla asks the Senate to fast-track Australia’s driverless car law by two years, and back an AV trial in 2027
stories.summary: Tesla asked the Senate Select Committee on Productivity in Australia to accelerate the proposed Autonomous Vehicle Safety Law from 2029 to 2027 and support an autonomous vehicle trial on public roads in 2027. The submission, dated 16 October 2026, cites independent modelling claiming these changes would save hundreds of lives and unlock more than A$10 billion in benefits.

stories.title: Sol.One secures EUR 5.5 million to launch Project SOLFORGE
stories.summary: Sol.One secured EUR 5.5 million in financing to launch Project SOLFORGE, a EUR 20 million investment plan. The company expects to complete the transaction by the end of November 2026.

stories.title: Toyota to Launch 'bZ4X' Robotaxi Service in 2027 with Waymo Partnership, a First for Japan
stories.summary: Toyota Motor Corporation announced on the 30th that it will begin full-scale operations of an unmanned autonomous taxi based on its battery electric vehicle 'bZ4X' in 2027, in collaboration with U.S. self-driving technology company Waymo. This project is a core initiative based on the strategic partnership signed by both companies in April 2025 and is drawing significant attention in the global mobility market.

stories.title: Toyota Motor, Waymo to Begin Autonomous Toyota bZ4X Fleet Testing in Japan in 2027
Toyota, Waymo to begin autonomous taxi trial service in Japan in 2027
stories.summary: Toyota Motor Corp. and Waymo LLC said Friday they will launch a trial service of autonomous taxis in Japan in 2027. The companies plan to use Toyota's bZ4X electric vehicles for testing and validation before commercializing the fully driverless service.

stories.title: Robots sell easily – profitable operation is the real challenge
stories.summary: The robotics market installed 603,307 new industrial robots worldwide in 2025, with 655,000 new installations expected in 2026. The article argues that economic viability depends on reliable real-world performance and cost-effectiveness rather than impressive demonstrations or sales figures.

stories.title: Toyota and Waymo Advance Autonomous Driving Collaboration for Safer Streets and Freedom of Movement for All
stories.summary: Toyota and Waymo announced plans to test an autonomous Toyota bZ4X fleet in Japan in 2027, with deployment to the United Kingdom and other markets planned for subsequent years. Toyota will build the vehicles at its Takaoka plant in Aichi Prefecture, integrating Waymo’s hardware under one roof.

stories.title: Honeywell, Shield AI demonstrate coordinated autonomous aircraft
stories.summary: Honeywell Aerospace and Shield AI completed two autonomous flight demonstrations, culminating in a coordinated intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance mission in which two aircraft shared target information and autonomously executed assigned actions. The demonstrations used Shield AI's Hivemind Enterprise autonomy platform, with the second mission conducted near Phoenix on 8 Oct. featuring a scout aircraft detecting a target and a second aircraft delivering a payload.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Houston 2026: Is the 254 Sq Mi Real?
stories.summary: Tesla expanded its driverless Robotaxi service in Houston on October 26, 2026, covering parts of Bellaire, the Heights, Montrose, Midtown, downtown Houston, and East Downtown. The company confirmed the expansion uses Model Y vehicles without a human driver or front-seat safety monitor, though it did not publish the service area size or population figures.

stories.title: This Indian Sound Based Anti-Drone System Can Destroy Any Drone Without Missile or Bullets
stories.summary: Scientists at the Chandigarh-based Council of Scientific and Industrial Research–Central Scientific Instruments Organisation (CSIR-CSIO) developed an indigenous sound-based anti-drone system that uses acoustic resonance to disrupt sensitive internal components like Micro-Electromechanical System (MEMS) gyroscopes. CSIR-CSIO published an Expression of Interest in August 2026 to identify industry partners for manufacturing and commercialising the technology.

stories.title: Archer Aviation, ITA Airways plan electric air taxis in Italy
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and ITA Airways signed an agreement to explore electric air taxi services in Italy using Archer's Midnight aircraft. The partnership aims to replace 60- to 90-minute ground journeys with 10- to 20-minute flights, potentially connecting Rome's Fiumicino Airport to the city center in under 10 minutes.

stories.title: ‘AI Robot Revolution to Open the Future of Korean Industry’: Robotworld Opens on the 4th of Next Month
stories.summary: The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy will host Robotworld 2026 from November 4 to 7 at KINTEX in Goyang City, featuring about 400 companies from 20 countries and 1,200 booths. The exhibition will showcase Physical AI-based robotics, humanoids, and Manufacturing AX technology, with a parallel conference featuring 36 sessions on intelligent automation and industrial applications.

stories.title: Toyota, Waymo to test autonomous bZ4Xs in Japan in 2027, eye overseas expansion
stories.summary: Toyota Motor and Waymo will begin testing autonomous bZ4X vehicles in Japan in 2027, with deployment in Britain planned for subsequent years. Toyota will build the cars at its Takaoka plant, where Waymo will install its autonomous-driving hardware.

stories.title: Toyota, Waymo to test autonomous bZ4Xs in Japan in 2027, eye overseas expansion
stories.summary: Toyota Motor and Alphabet’s Waymo will begin testing autonomous electric vehicles in Japan in 2027, with deployment in Britain and potentially other markets planned in subsequent years. Toyota will build the bZ4X models at its Takaoka plant, where Waymo’s autonomous-driving hardware will also be installed.

stories.title: Prague to Budapest by high-speed rail? Czechia and Hungary seek EU funds
stories.summary: Czechia and Hungary will jointly seek EU funding for high-speed rail development, including a proposed connection between Prague, Brno, Bratislava and Budapest. Prime Minister Andrej Babiš announced the plan Thursday following the first joint consultations between the Czech and Hungarian governments in Prague.

stories.title: French Navy to deploy VTOL drones on support vessels from late 2026
stories.summary: The French Navy will deploy the vertical take-off and landing version of Airbus Helicopters' U010 Aliaca unmanned aerial vehicle aboard its metropolitan support and assistance ships in late 2026. The DGA ordered 34 systems comprising 68 drones, with delivery of 27 systems completed and the remaining seven due before 2026 ends.

stories.title: what a wonderful world this will be
stories.summary: The article describes how artificial intelligence and machine learning enable drones to perform autonomous flight, predictive analytics, and swarm robotics. It states that these systems allow drones to navigate complex environments, analyze crop health, and coordinate with human operators to improve safety and efficiency in industries such as agriculture and search and rescue.

stories.title: Elbit Systems to Unveil Underwater Drone Capabilities at Euronaval 2026
stories.summary: Elbit Systems Ltd. will showcase its Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV) capabilities for the first time at Euronaval 2026, expanding its autonomous maritime portfolio across air, surface, and underwater domains. The expansion follows its acquisition of International Submarine Engineering Ltd. (ISE), a Canadian developer of autonomous underwater systems that has delivered more than 250 vehicles to customers in over 20 countries.

stories.title: Waymo taps Toyota to supply robotaxis for Japan and the U.K.
stories.summary: Waymo will begin testing autonomous Toyota bZ4X vehicles in Japan next year as part of a partnership to provide electric vehicles for robotaxi operations in international markets, including the U.K. Toyota will manufacture the 2027 bZ4X vehicles and integrate Waymo’s self-driving system at its Takaoka factory in Japan.

stories.title: US Military Counter-Drone Defenses Could Cost $74 Million Per Base
stories.summary: The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) estimated in 2026 that outfitting a typical U.S. military installation with a layered counter-drone defense system would cost approximately $74 million upfront, with a total funding projection of $7.4 billion and annual upkeep of $5 million per installation.

stories.title: Rogue Cortex Emerges from Stealth with $4.5M in funding to Simplify Robotics Development
Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Drone Over Makkah
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone over the Makkah region on October 30. Coalition spokesperson Major General Turki Al-Malki also confirmed the destruction of a cruise missile targeted at the Kingdom’s western region.

stories.title: Ericsson, Play and Asseco show detection of unauthorized drones for Polish authorities
stories.summary: Ericsson, Play and Asseco demonstrated a multi-layered sensing solution using mobile networks to detect drones and protect sensitive locations in Poland such as airports, ports and borders. The live demonstration took place at Ericsson R&D Center in Kraków on October 15, showcasing Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication technology and Asseco’s PUSZCZYK system.

stories.title: Tesla Extends Robotaxi Hours to 2 AM With Share and Calm Mode
stories.summary: Tesla extended Robotaxi operating hours to 2 AM on October 29, adding three hours to the previous 11 PM cutoff. The update also introduced a rear-view camera feed, trip sharing, and Calm Mode, which dims the cabin screen and adjusts lighting.

stories.title: Monthly Drone Report – October 2026
stories.summary: The Coast Guard ordered four MQ-9B SeaGuardian drones from General Atomics to monitor offshore waters and support search and rescue missions. The unarmed aircraft can fly more than 30 hours and will improve the service's ability to protect borders and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Kim urges drone dominance as North Korea fires missiles and rockets
stories.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for “absolute superiority” in drone technology during a Friday exhibition, state media KCNA reported. The event featured tactical suicide attack drones, cruise missiles, and 600 mm multiple rocket launchers, reflecting Pyongyang’s push to modernize its armed forces using drones and artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Railway Supply Industry News Round-Up: Acquisitions, Facility Investments and Expansion Plans
stories.summary: PRM Australia acquired Swietelsky Rail Australia to expand its east coast operations and equipment base, while Alstom upgraded its București testing laboratory to strengthen ERTMS and train control system validation capabilities.

stories.title: World’s first legged robot built for explosive atmospheres enters delivery phase
stories.summary: ANYbotics began shipping ANYmal X, the world’s first legged inspection robot for explosive atmospheres, to customers including Equinor and DSM-Firmenich. The robot uses integrated thermal, visual, acoustic, and gas sensors to detect overheating, leaks, abnormal noise, and equipment wear, logging readings directly to assets to provide reliability engineers with a standardized baseline for tracking health over time.

stories.title: Campus Guardian Angel drone plan hits budget roadblock as lawmakers cite $13M unspent
Railway supply industry news round-up
stories.summary: Zimbabwe's government approved accession to an international treaty to facilitate private sector financing of rolling stock. Pandrol will open a rail fastening factory in Riyadh with Links Investments, while Keolis opened a regional headquarters in Dubai to develop Middle East business opportunities.

stories.title: JIATF-401 Leads a New Era in Counter-SUAS Defense
stories.summary: The Joint Interagency Task Force 401, established in August 2025, leads the Department of War’s counter-small unmanned aircraft systems efforts by utilizing unique procurement authorities to bypass traditional timelines. The task force launched drones.mil, a centralized marketplace for rapid technology acquisition, and established an enterprise-wide agreement for a common tactical user interface to enable plug-and-play interoperability across a layered defense system.

stories.title: Over 100 dead in eight months: Spain faces backlash over high-speed rail safety
stories.summary: Spain's high-speed rail network faces scrutiny after two crashes in eight months killed over 100 people, including 69 near Toledo and 46 in Adamuz. Preliminary findings indicate a signaling malfunction and manual control errors, while experts cite low maintenance spending and the absence of the European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS) as contributing factors.

stories.title: Why Does Spain Keep Having Deadly Rail Accidents?
stories.summary: A signaling failure on the Madrid-Seville high-speed line caused a Renfe train to collide with a stationary Iryo train, killing at least 69 people. Transport Minister Óscar Puente blamed the operator's decision to allow the Renfe train to resume travel at normal speed despite the obstruction.

stories.title: LG Builds the Brains, Samsung the Hands in Humanoid Robot Race With China
stories.summary: LG Electronics plans to bring a 10,000-square-meter “Data Factory” in Seoul into full operation in the fourth quarter to accumulate 500,000 hours of robot training data this year. The company targets unveiling a bipedal humanoid robot based on Nvidia’s Isaac GR00T model in the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Why Spain Is Re-examining Its High-speed Rail Network After The Toledo Disaster
stories.summary: Transport Minister Óscar Puente labeled the movement order that allowed a train from Madrid to plow into the rear of a stationary service an "inexplicable decision." Ongoing transport ministry investigations examine whether the crash resulted from human error, flawed manual fallback procedures, or broader oversight failures.

stories.title: New Robot Usability Questionnaire Passes Key Validation Test With AI and Non-AI Robots
stories.summary: Researchers at the German Federal Institute for Occupational Safety and Health validated the Usability Questionnaire for Robotic Systems with 64 participants using Spot and MiR 250 robots. The study confirmed the instrument's convergent validity, showing it works consistently whether users believe they are operating an AI-based system or a conventional one.

stories.title: UN takes its automated driving rulebook on tour through Beijing
stories.summary: UN officials used a Beijing conference to press for harmonized automated driving rules, with UNECE deputy executive secretary Dmitry Mariyasin noting China's central role in drafting the framework. The event highlighted regulatory progress in Canada and Russia, while noting that no timetable for binding national alignment emerged.

stories.title: Amazon’s delivery drones are built to fly through rain, extreme heat and freezing temperatures
stories.summary: Amazon Air drones deliver packages weighing 5 pounds or less within two hours, operating in rain, extreme heat, and below-freezing temperatures. The service is currently available in 14 cities across nine states, with plans to expand to nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of the year.

stories.title: Spain reckons with second deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
stories.summary: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year killed 69 people when one train struck another from behind near Urda. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez pledged an investigation and safety improvements ahead of the Nov. 29 national election.

stories.title: US tests self-powered counter-drone system, can be set up quickly without relying on local power
stories.summary: Soldiers in the United States are testing Trust Automation’s Rapidly Deployable Small-Unmanned Air Defense System, or RD-SUADS, a palletized counter-drone system designed to detect, track, identify and defeat small drones. The self-powered unit fits on a standard 463L military cargo pallet and incorporates an integrated diesel generator providing up to four days of independent operation between refueling.

stories.title: California high-speed rail chief quits amid billowing expenses scandal
stories.summary: California high-speed rail chief Ian Choudri resigned Wednesday, citing personal priorities, after a state inspector general report found the agency paid $543,000 in disallowed travel reimbursements. Joe Stephenshaw, director of California’s department of finance, will serve as interim CEO.

stories.title: FAA Amends Class D Airspace and Establishes Class E Airspace at Chandler and Phoenix, AZ, Raising Chandler Class D Ceiling to Below 4,000 Feet MSL
stories.summary: The FAA issued a final rule amending Class D airspace and establishing Class E airspace at Chandler and Phoenix, AZ, raising the Chandler Class D ceiling to below 4,000 feet MSL. The action follows biennial airspace reviews under FAA Order JO 7400.2R and updates coordinates for Mesa Gateway Airport.

stories.title: Rail service partly suspended after Spain's deadly train collision
stories.summary: Rail services between Madrid and Andalusia were suspended on Thursday after a Renfe-operated AVE train struck a stationary Iryo train near Urda station in the province of Toledo on Wednesday. Spain's independent transport accident investigation authority AITAT reported the death toll reached 69, while Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez pledged a thorough investigation into the collision.

stories.title: Rolling Business Aviation Daily Briefs (October 2026)
stories.summary: Wing and Walmart are expanding drone delivery service to Denver and Seattle in 2027, adding to existing operations in Dallas-Fort Worth, Atlanta, Houston, and Orlando. The expansion supports plans to serve more than 270 Walmart locations across the U.S. by the end of 2027.

stories.title: DJI Teases a Folding Thermal Drone for November 5 With the 5TD Gimbal
stories.summary: DJI Enterprise will launch a new product on November 5, 2026, at 7 AM EST, featuring a folding airframe and a gimbal matching the Matrice 5TD’s window layout. The teaser highlights a 1280 by 1024 thermal sensor, a capability the FCC’s Docket 26-189 proposal defines as “military-grade” and proposes barring from import and sale.

stories.title: FCC clears drone operations in 800MHz band
stories.summary: The FCC voted to remove a restriction preventing drones from operating in 50 megahertz of spectrum in the 800 MHz band. The Commission stated that modern wireless networks employ advanced technologies to prevent interference, making the decades-old airborne use restriction unnecessary for unmanned aircraft systems.

stories.title: China Tightens Export Controls on Drone Engines, Autopilots and Communication Systems
stories.summary: China will require export licenses for drone components, including autopilots and engines, starting 18 November. The Ministry of Commerce issued the measures on 19 October, covering items like brushless motors rated at 48 V or more and drones capable of beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Chief Executive Resigns After State Investigators Question Spending
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, chief executive for California’s High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned on Wednesday after state investigators questioned spending. Joe Stephenshaw, who previously led the state Department of Finance, will replace Choudri. State investigators found consultants flew first class and traveled to a nightclub on taxpayers’ dime, sometimes at Choudri’s request. The board voted earlier this month to limit Choudri’s contracting authority, requiring in-house legal counsel to sign off first on contracts under $25 million.

stories.title: Midwest Unmanned Aircraft System test site launches in Indiana
stories.summary: Indiana launched the Midwest Unmanned Air Systems Test Site at Terre Haute Regional Airport on Thursday, creating a regional resource for companies, defense organizations, public-safety agencies, and researchers developing next-generation drones and autonomous aviation technologies.

stories.title: YYForce Deploys 11 Commercial Hospitality Robots at Novotel & Mercure Singapore on Stevens
stories.summary: YYForce Inc. deployed an 11-robot autonomous service fleet at the Novotel Singapore on Stevens and Mercure Singapore on Stevens complex under a 24-month commercial agreement. The robots handle intra-hotel logistics, guest room deliveries, and inter-floor service workflows.

stories.title: FCDO updates Spain rail warning after Toledo crash
stories.summary: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office updated its Spain travel advice on 28 October 2026 following a deadly high-speed rail collision near Toledo. The advisory warns of significant disruption to rail services in central and southern Spain and directs passengers to Renfe for assistance.

stories.title: Final stage in mega Sydney rail project opens for commuters
stories.summary: The final stage of Sydney’s Metro rail project opened to commuters on Friday, with the inaugural 4.31am service departing Bankstown station. The line, which cost just under $23 billion, features ten new stations and offers services every four minutes during peak times, reducing travel to the Sydney CBD to 28 minutes.

stories.title: Lt. Gov. Driscoll, State Officials Break Ground on Pittsfield Rail Improvements
stories.summary: State officials broke ground on rail infrastructure improvements in Pittsfield, Mass., to support the permanent Berkshire Flyer and future West-East Rail connections. The project includes a fourth track turnout and siding rehabilitation at the Pittsfield yard, funded by an $18 million MassDOT investment.

stories.title: EDA to launch drone technology hubs in Latvia and Netherlands with 2027 exercises
stories.summary: The European Defence Agency will organize 2027 operational exercises to develop Drone Technology Hubs in Selonia, Latvia, and Scheveningen, the Netherlands. These pilot hubs, part of the EU’s Priority Capability Area on Drone and Counter-Drone Systems, will focus on aerial, ground, and maritime drone technologies to accelerate innovation for armed forces.

stories.title: Spain mourns 69 killed in train crash as safety failures investigated
stories.summary: Spain declared three days of national mourning after a train collision near Urda killed at least 69 people. Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated that rail controllers allowed a Renfe train to resume travelling despite another service remaining stationary on the same track, a decision he described as inexplicable.

stories.title: Philly considers new tax on Uber Eats robots and Waymo driverless taxis
stories.summary: Councilmember Jim Harrity introduced a proposal Thursday to tax companies operating delivery robots and driverless vehicles in Philadelphia. The bill calls for a 5% tax on gross cost or $0.50 for delivery services, and 5% or $1 for transportation services, with revenue directed to the Zero Fare Program.

stories.title: Foundry Robotics Raises $100 Million Series A Led By Marlinspike Partners
stories.summary: Foundry Robotics raised $100 million in a Series A led by Marlinspike Partners to build a 130,000-square-foot factory in Emeryville, California. The company plans to use the funds to expand its autonomous manufacturing platform and increase its manufacturing footprint approximately twentyfold.

stories.title: ITA Airways Teams Up with Archer Aviation to Bring eVTOL Taxis to Italy
stories.summary: ITA Airways and Archer Aviation announced an agreement on 29 May to evaluate electric vertical take-off and landing air taxi services across major Italian cities using the Archer Midnight eVTOL. The deal marks ITA as the first European airline in Archer's partner network, though no routes, launch dates, or aircraft orders have been specified.

stories.title: Blaine receives $66 million to build overpass at Bell Road rail crossing
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration awarded Blaine $66.4 million to build an overpass at the Bell Road rail crossing, replacing the existing at-grade intersection. The city has begun preliminary design and is taking public feedback, with no timeline yet for construction to begin.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone defenses debunk the myth of inevitable Russian victory
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces shot down over four hundred thousand Russian drones since the beginning of 2026 using expanding fleets of FPV drones and specialized interceptors. This drone-based air defense capability has enabled Ukraine to restrict Russia’s offensive capabilities and launch successful small-scale counteroffensives that liberated strategically important territory.

stories.title: White House makes Section 232 determination regarding foreign-made robots
Trump Holds Off on New Machinery, Robotics Tariffs in Win for Manufacturers
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced it will impose no new tariffs on robotics, industrial machinery, and their parts and components. The Department of Commerce and USTR must jointly pursue negotiations to address national security threats, with updates due to the president within 180 days.

stories.title: Autonomous A2Z Develops Skateboard-Style Self-Driving Cargo Vehicle
stories.summary: Autonomous A2Z developed a skateboard-style self-driving cargo vehicle capable of carrying up to 1.3 tons of freight. The company completed the platform under a government-funded project supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, with partners including KC Motors and Chungbuk National University. The vehicle retains Level 4 self-driving sensors from the ROii model while adding a flat upper deck for industrial parts. In 2027, Autonomous A2Z will demonstrate freight transport between parts suppliers and the Gwangju Global Motors assembly plant to refine a commercial model.

stories.title: Audio recordings reveal decisions made moments before deadly train crash in Spain
stories.summary: The Madrid control center authorized a Renfe high-speed train to resume its journey at normal speed without limitations, despite a stationary Iryo train ahead, causing a collision that killed at least 69 people. Transportation minister Óscar Puente stated the decision broke protocol after a computer malfunction stopped multiple trains at 8:30 a.m.

stories.title: 2026 Robotics Handbook looks at humanoids, AI, and design choices
USA Tested RD-SUADS Anti-Drone Electronic Warfare System in Germany
stories.summary: U.S. service members from the Army, Air Force, and Marine Corps tested the RD-SUADS electronic warfare system at the Grafenwöhr training area in Germany. The Trust Automation-developed system features a 170 × 274 × 229 cm container, four radar panels, and a diesel generator supporting four days of continuous operation.

stories.title: Safety-Constrained Model Predictive Control Keeps a Simulated Autonomous
stories.summary: Ali Mahmood and Róbert Szabolcsi published a simulation study in Discover Vehicles demonstrating that a safety-constrained nonlinear model predictive control approach keeps a virtual vehicle inside road boundaries during lane changes under disturbances. The controller maintained peak lateral tracking errors below 0.25 meters across four test phases, including simultaneous velocity and steering noise, while satisfying hard constraints on lateral acceleration and road boundaries at every simulation step.

stories.title: Ukraine is getting ground robots to carry out one of the riskiest battlefield tasks — and they're doing an excellent job
Matternet Partners with Swisslog Healthcare to Bring M3 Drone Delivery to North American Hospitals
stories.summary: Matternet partnered with TransLogic, a Swisslog Healthcare company, to expand drone delivery across North American hospitals using the M3 platform. The companies plan to begin working with hospital systems in California, Florida, and Arizona during the first year of the partnership.

stories.title: Pentagon Becomes eVTOL Industry's Largest Customer, Giving Archer and Joby Early Revenue
stories.summary: The Pentagon became the largest customer of the electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) industry, delivering early and reliable revenue to developers Archer Aviation and Joby Aviation. This military demand offsets the long wait for commercial air taxi certification and launch, strengthening the investment case for both companies.

stories.title: Why The US Navy Is Awarding Boeing Up To $80 Million To Improve A Drone That Isn't Even Operational Yet
stories.summary: The US Navy's Naval Air Systems Command finalized an $80 million contract with Boeing to improve the MQ-25A Stingray, the first carrier-capable unmanned aerial vehicle. The indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity agreement secures engineering and system-improvement work through October 2031, focusing on maturing the Unmanned Carrier Aviation Mission Control System and developing specialized Ground Control Stations.

stories.title: Germany and Ukraine test armed ground robot for frontline deployment
stories.summary: German and Ukrainian defence companies tested the GEREON armed ground robot, with the first systems fitted with the SABER weapons module due for delivery by the end of 2026. The cooperation agreement was signed in early October during German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's state visit to Kyiv.

stories.title: New Jersey Bill Could Bar Tesla's Camera-Only Robotaxis From State Pilot
stories.summary: New Jersey Senate Bill 1677 would require fully autonomous vehicles to include a camera system plus two distinct sensing modalities, a threshold Tesla’s camera-only robotaxis would likely fail. The bill mandates 50,000 miles of supervised in-state testing without a major incident before companies can remove human safety drivers.

stories.title: Europe's trains are actually getting safer, despite recent tragedies in Spain
stories.summary: Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente stated that a computer system failure stopped six trains on just over 60km of track between Madrid and Seville, while another was manually given clearance to move.

stories.title: UC engineers drones that know if they're damaged
stories.summary: University of Cincinnati doctoral student Prissha Chawla and her research partners converted drone motor and propeller sounds into data that ground station computers use to alert operators that a drone is not airworthy before takeoff. The project, which began in 2024 with NASA interest, aims to prevent crashes by detecting chipped, cracked, or failing components.

stories.title: Waymo Ojai Privacy: 5 Risks Riders Should Know [2026]
stories.summary: Missy Cummings of George Mason University called for an independent investigation of Waymo's Zeekr-built Ojai vans after AZ Family reported privacy concerns on October 28-29, 2026. Waymo states the vehicles arrive without connected-car technology and that it shares no rider identity data with the automaker, while a bipartisan bill to ban China-built vehicles cleared the Senate Commerce Committee in July.

stories.title: Greek container ship goes down off Bulgaria after naval drone strike
stories.summary: The Bulgarian Government said a Greek container ship sank after being hit by naval drones off Bulgaria on Wednesday. The Liberian-flagged Contship Jet, loaded with 421 containers, was badly damaged by three sea drones as it passed through Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone.

stories.title: Elbit to unveil underwater drones as it expands autonomous naval portfolio
stories.summary: Elbit Systems will present its unmanned underwater vehicle capabilities for the first time at Euronaval 2026, expanding its autonomous naval portfolio after acquiring International Submarine Engineering. The company plans to showcase the technology alongside its Seagull family of unmanned surface vessels, though Israeli exhibitors face restrictions at the French event.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Authority names new interim CEO after former chief's abrupt resignation
stories.summary: The High-Speed Rail Board appointed Department of Finance head Joe Stephenshaw as interim CEO after Ian Choudri resigned Wednesday night. Stephenshaw begins his role on Nov. 3, replacing Choudri, who was stripped of contracting power following an audit revealing nearly $593,000 in unallowable expenses.

stories.title: Fresno carrier DTL to run 75 Kodiak driverless trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI signed a binding agreement Wednesday to put its autonomous driving system in 75 trucks owned by DTL Transport, a Fresno, California, carrier. DTL will pay a per-mile fee to use the Kodiak Driver on lanes between Dallas and El Paso, Texas, and Interstate 20 between Dallas and Atlanta.

stories.title: AUVSI Gives the FCC as Many Speakers as the FAA at Its DC Drone Forum
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) announced the program for its Drone & AAM Policy Symposium, November 9 and 10 at Nationals Park in Washington. Its published speaker list names four Federal Communications Commission officials and four from the FAA, which also gets an executive session of its own.

stories.title: Greek cargo ship sinks after drone strike off Bulgaria
stories.summary: A Greek container ship sank off Bulgaria's coast after being struck by naval drones Wednesday, the Bulgarian government said. The Liberian-flagged CONTSHIP JET, loaded with 421 containers, was badly damaged by three sea drones as it passed through Bulgaria's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).

stories.title: Can inertial navigation make ground-robot swarms real?
Philly is once again looking at a $1-per-ride tax. But this time, it’s on the robots.
Inside AGCO’s Humanoid Robot Pilot with Agility Robotics
stories.summary: AGCO signed a commercial agreement with Agility Robotics to pilot its Digit humanoid robot at its Hesston, Kansas, production facility starting in 2027. The robot will initially sort and stack parts and place totes for storage, tasks chosen to improve ergonomic safety by absorbing repetitive, physically demanding work.

stories.title: Rantizo Prototype Pairs GPS With LORAN, Which the US Shut Off in 2010
stories.summary: Rantizo unveiled a prototype fixed-wing surveillance drone on October 28, listing GPS and LORAN for navigation despite the US Coast Guard shutting down its LORAN-C network in 2010. The company expects the aircraft on sale in mid-2027, with a targeted range of up to 130 miles and a top speed of 75 mph.

stories.title: Ship that was hit by drones off Bulgaria sinks; Filipinos, other crew safe in Varna
stories.summary: The Bulgarian government said a Greek container ship hit by naval drones off Bulgaria on Wednesday has sunk. The Liberian-flagged CONTSHIP JET, loaded with 421 containers, was damaged by three sea drones while passing through Bulgaria's Exclusive Economic Zone.

stories.title: Europe can benefit from driverless tech developed in US: Volvo Group
stories.summary: Ingor Stürmer, head of Volvo Autonomous Solutions, said lessons from self-driving truck tests in North America could help bring commercial applications to Europe in the near future. He noted that the biggest challenge for Europe is the multi-nation make up of the region with a myriad of different transport regulations.

stories.title: FCC Opens 800 MHz Spectrum to Drones as Part 108 Deadline Nears
